messages:
Sam (Infra): Posting follow-ups from today's all-hands about region sequencing, autoscaler defaults, and short-term GPU supply. Will answer throughout the day.

Lina (SRE): Any change to the rollout order for regions? Customers asking about APAC timing.

Sam (Infra): Order unchanged: US-east first, then EMEA, then APAC. APAC depends on partner window and freight; tentatively early Q3.

Omar (Product): If APAC slips, can we offer temporary routing options closer to APAC?

Sam (Infra): We can enable nearer-cloud POPs for egress to reduce latency for some customers, but full in-region GPU pools require procurement.

Jun (Runtime): Autoscaler update: default local_buffer=0.1, burst_to_cross_region when predicted_p99 < 180ms. Customers with Dedicated can set stricter thresholds.

Lina (SRE): Is that 180ms a hard limit?

Jun (Runtime): Soft default. Per-route override available. We'll show predicted p99 in Console during canary.

deploy-bot: Autoscaler v1.4 canary started  3% traffic  logs: https://ci.redwood/canary-210123

Omar (Product): Action: add "predicted p99" and a "cross-region opt-out" toggle to the route UI. I'll own docs.

Sam (Infra): Procurement note: mixed A100/H100 EMEA shipment expected by 2101400000; will prioritize H100s for low-latency pools.

Lina (SRE): Perf validation plan?

Jun (Runtime): I'll run standard benchmarks and publish numbers to the model catalog within 48hrs of hardware live.

Sam (Infra): Thanks all 44B. If you have customer-specific concerns DM me or drop them here.
